_comment: Characters that are easy to mix up. script: both (the same in Traditional and Simplified), cn (only alike in Simplified), hk (only alike in Traditional). hint: how to tell them apart. Only frequent characters: a set earns its place when the characters come up all the time.

sets.hint: 句 has a hook 勹 wrapped around the mouth 口 from above (a sentence: 这句话). 可 has a straight line on top and the hook 亅 standing to the right of 口 (can: 可以).
杯 has wood 木 on the left (a wooden cup: 一杯咖啡). 块 has earth 土 (a lump of earth, a piece; with money, a dollar: 一块钱).
杯 has wood 木 on the left (a wooden cup: 一杯咖啡). 塊 has earth 土 (a lump of earth, a piece; with money, a dollar: 一塊錢).
Both zài. 在 has the ground 土 inside: being somewhere (at, in). 再 is a stack of layers with a line through it: one more time (again: 再见).
字 has a roof 宀 (a child at home learning letters). 学 has three strokes ⺍ on top, like sparks of thought.
儿 is two separate strokes with nothing on top: two legs (child). 几 has a lid joining them across the top: a little table (how many).
大 a person with arms out (big). 天 one line above the head (sky). 太 a dot underneath (too, very). 关 two horns 丷 on top of 天 (close).
大 a person with arms out (big). 天 one line above the head (sky). 太 a dot underneath (too, very).
有 has 月 (meat) in a hand: to have. 友 has 又 (a second hand): two hands together, a friend.
人 the left stroke is longer (a person striding). 入 the right stroke is longer (going in). 八 the strokes don't touch (splitting apart, eight).
日 one line inside (the sun). 目 two lines inside and taller (an eye on its side).
午 the middle stroke stops at the top line (noon). 牛 it pokes through like a horn (cow).
Both sit in a door 门. 问 has a mouth 口 in it: asking at the door. 间 has the sun 日: light through the gap (between, room).
Both sit in a door 門. 問 has a mouth 口 in it: asking at the door. 間 has the sun 日: light through the gap (between, room).
卖 has an extra 十 on top: you add something on top when you sell (mài). 买 without it is buy (mǎi).
賣 has an extra 士 on top: you add something on top when you sell (mài). 買 without it is buy (mǎi).
我 has an extra stroke at the top-left: me, holding my weapon. 找 starts with the hand 扌: looking for something with your hand.
白 the sun with one ray (white). 百 adds a line on top: one 一 + 白, a hundred.
见 the legs open out to the right (see). 贝 the legs are a small 人 under the box (shell, money).
見 an eye 目 on walking legs (see). 貝 the legs are two little strokes under the box (shell, money).
他 has a person 亻 in front: him. 也 alone: also.
了 just a hook (done). 子 adds a crossbar: a baby with arms out (child).
东 ends in a hook with a dot on each side (east). 车 ends in a cross 十 with a long base line (car).
All tā. 他 person 亻 (he). 她 woman 女 (she). 它 roof 宀 over a curl, for things (it).
All say 马 (horse) for the sound. 吗 has a mouth 口: the spoken question mark. 妈 has woman 女: mum.
All say 馬 (horse) for the sound. 嗎 has a mouth 口: the spoken question mark. 媽 has woman 女: mum.
门 is the door. 们 puts a person 亻 in front: people at the door, the plural ending (我们, 你们).
門 is the door. 們 puts a person 亻 in front: people at the door, the plural ending (我們, 你們).
Both have speech 讠 on the left. 说 (say) has 兑 on the right, with two little horns on top. 话 (words) has 舌, the tongue.
Both have speech 言 on the left. 說 (say) has 兌 on the right, with two little horns on top. 話 (words) has 舌, the tongue.
Same right side. 喝 has a mouth 口: to drink. 渴 has water 氵: thirsty, wanting water.
Same 青 for the sound; the left part gives the meaning. 请 speech 讠: please, ask. 情 heart 忄: feeling. 清 water 氵: clear.
Same 青 for the sound; the left part gives the meaning. 請 speech 言: please, ask. 情 heart 忄: feeling. 清 water 氵: clear.
